items.title: Microsoft Security update: Execution Containers and Defender local AI agent discovery reach general availability
items.summary_en: Microsoft's November security roundup says Microsoft Execution Containers (MXC) is generally available. It is an OS-enforced containment layer that applies least-privilege limits to what AI agents can access on Windows. Defender's discovery of local AI agents is also generally available. It finds more than 50 supported agents on Windows and macOS and links each to its device, account and configured MCPs. Planned integration with Intune, Entra and Agent 365 is described.

items.title: IBM and Microsoft announce an agent platform for industry-specific use
items.summary_en: According to the Microsoft Source headline and a search-tool summary, IBM and Microsoft announced a new agentic platform (reported as Imagine Enterprise) for building, running and governing industry-specific AI agents. It reportedly targets financial services, insurance and retail first, with later expansion to other sectors.

items.title: Ignite 2026 preview: Agent 365 guide and Copilot plugin catalog (event is Nov 17-20)
items.summary_en: Microsoft's Tech Community previews Ignite 2026, which runs 17-20 November in San Francisco. Agent 365 is positioned as an observability and governance layer for agents. A public Plugin Catalog is slated to launch on 17 November. These are previews, not announcements made at the event.
